verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Asana hosts a working llms.txt at developers.asana.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured documentation guidance (including markdown-append instructions for pages), which is exactly the agent-oriented docs entry point the story asks for. This is independently verified via probe rather than just vendor claim, though there's no broader agent-doc ecosystem (e.g., no confirmed OpenAPI json endpoint) beyond this single file. Missing for 10: independent commentary/community validation of the llms.txt usage, and confirmation of additional agent-oriented doc formats beyond the single llms.txt file.
